WP(C).No. 20741 of 2015 (P) Appendix Petitioner'S Exhibits:- Ext. P1: The True Copy Of The Certificate Issued By The Shivam Betelnut Pvt. P3: The True Copy Of The Certificate Of Examination Issued By The Food Analyst. Ext . P4: The True Copy Of The Certificate Issued By The Commercial Tax Officer, Kunnamkulam To The Petitioner . Vinod Chandran, J -------------------------------------- W.P.(C).No.20741 of 2015-P -------------------------------------- Dated this the 16th day of July, 2015 Judgment
texts.facts: The petitioner has been before various forums, attempting to carry on indiscriminate sale of "PANRAJ" panmasala within the State. 2. The petitioner was earlier before this Court alleging police harassment, on the ground that huge quantities of product has been seized and the same causes hardship to the petitioner.
texts.arguments: 3. In the present case, the petitioner's contention is that the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 [for brevity "FSSA"] is not being followed. The learned Government Pleader, however, submits that the product has been seized adjacent to a school and the 1st respondent, who has seized the product, has sent it for examination to the Regional Forensic Laboratory.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. In the present case, the petitioner's contention is that the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 [for brevity "FSSA"] is not being followed. The learned Government Pleader, however, submits that the product has been seized adjacent to a school and the 1st respondent, who has seized the product, has sent it for examination to the Regional Forensic Laboratory.
